facts.fact: 代主人赴会的 Mr. Jack 自我介绍：B.L.T. 没来，信息他全有。
facts.anchor: “Apologies, Mr. B.L.T. couldn’t make it, but I am Mr. Jack, and I have been provided all of the information needed and can assist with any necessary items.”

facts.fact: 会面让她意识到自己当私人厨师毫无准备。
facts.anchor: This entire meeting has made me realize how little I am prepared to be a private chef.

facts.fact: 她会做饭，但完全不会谈生意。
facts.anchor: Do I know how to cook? Hell yeah. Do I know how to handle a business? No. No, I do not.

facts.fact: Mr. Jack 保证此处安全、对话不会外传。
facts.anchor: “Miss Cinnamon, rest assured this is a safe location and our conversation will not spread to any ears.

facts.fact: 她想问自己将为谁下厨。
facts.anchor: “Who—I mean, who will I be c—”

facts.fact: Mr. Jack 打断她，答「最后才轮到他」。
facts.anchor: Mr. Jack interrupts, his eyes widening in surprise. “At the end.”

facts.fact: 她注意到 Jack 耳朵里戴着耳机。
facts.anchor: I clock that he has an ear piece.

facts.fact: 她说这单只有一个「人头」，不想自带装备。
她说平常一桌至少五个人。
facts.anchor: “I usually have a minimum of five in one sitting.”

facts.fact: 被问特殊需求，她答：肉桂——给所有客户的独家配料。
facts.anchor: “Cinnamon.” The response is immediate. “It is my special ingredient for all my clients.”

facts.fact: 她的计划：做菜、上菜、走人。
facts.anchor: “I will make a meal, serve it to the person as requested, and then I will depart.”

facts.fact: Jack 递上写有姓名与地址的纸条。
facts.anchor: Here is the name and address.

facts.fact: 纸条上的目标名字：Julienne Napolitan。
地址在城外，至少一小时车程。
facts.anchor: The address is outside of town and will be at least an hour drive.
